label: ivr
scenario: Insurance DTMF claim-status line reads back the claim record (status, adjuster, dates) and repeats it verbatim on request.
task: Check the status of the customer's homeowner's insurance claim.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Thank you for calling Pinecrest Insurance. This call may be monitored or recorded for quality purposes. If you are calling to file a new claim, press 1. To check the status of an existing claim, press 2. For policy and billing questions, press 3. To repeat these options, press 9.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Please enter your nine-digit claim number, followed by the pound key.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Please hold while we retrieve your claim information.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Claim number 3 1 0 5 5 7 8 4 2. Status: under review. An adjuster has been assigned. Your adjuster is Nadia Farrell. The most recent update was received on September 10th. Estimated decision date: September 24th. To repeat this information, press 1. To speak with your adjuster, press 2. To return to the main menu, press star.
